_comment: Metadata for the Selenium + Java + Cucumber template. Mirrors the Playwright/Java/Cucumber layout — same package structure, same dotenv-java config, same JUnit-Platform-driven Cucumber runner — but uses WebDriver via WebDriverManager instead of the Playwright Java client. The seeder (deploy_team_templates.py) ingests this directory verbatim and creates a ProjectTemplates row keyed by (tool, language, framework).
description: Enterprise Selenium Java Cucumber BDD Template (JUnit 5 + WebDriverManager + Maven)
